distribution.summary: Anhui; Chongqing; Fujian; Guangdong; Guangxi; Guizhou; Hainan; Heilongjiang; Henan; Hubei; Hunan; Jiangsu; Jiangxi; Shaanxi; Shandong; Shanxi; Sichuan; Xizang; Yunnan; Zhejiang; Taiwan; Hong Kong
distribution.narrative: Lin et al. (2024) adds Heilongjiang and Shandong in its reviewed range and confirms Jiangsu as a new provincial record. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently accepts Taiwan occurrence and reports the species broadly from China and Taiwan. Lau (2025), Checklist of Insects of Hong Kong, 2nd edition, provides secondary checklist evidence for Hong Kong occurrence.

host_note: Lin et al. (2024) directly reports Populus przewalskii; prior hosts are retained. Beaver & Liu (2010) describes the species as strongly polyphagous, with more than 200 species in over 50 families reported, but this broad prose is retained at source level and does not generate additional current host taxa.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xylosandrus germanus (Blandford, 1894).
